```{r message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(epiDisplay)
library(readxl)
```


#Creating a duplicate dataset to run analysis
```{r, include = FALSE}
load(file.path(path_to_analytic_data, "CABBS_cleaned.RData"))
table1_data <- filtered_data
```



#Creating harmonized CABBS variables

#Creating a new harmonized categorical age variable in CABBS to align with BRFSS data
```{r}
library(dplyr)

table1_data <- table1_data %>%
  mutate(Age_harm = case_when(
    Age_Referral >= 55 & Age_Referral <= 59 ~ 1,
    Age_Referral >= 60 & Age_Referral <= 64 ~ 2,
    Age_Referral >= 65 & Age_Referral <= 69 ~ 3,
    Age_Referral >= 70 & Age_Referral <= 74 ~ 4,
    Age_Referral >= 75 & Age_Referral <= 79 ~ 5,
    Age_Referral >= 80 ~ 6,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ))

table(table1_data$Age_harm)


#1 = 55 - 59
#2 = 60 - 64
#3 = 65 - 69
#4 = 70 - 74
#5 = 75 - 79
#6 = 80 or older
```


#Creating a new harmonized sex/gender variable in CABBS to align with BRFSS data

```{r}
library(dplyr)

table1_data <- table1_data %>%
  mutate(Female_harm = case_when(
    Gender == "Male" ~ 0,
    Gender == "Female" ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ))

table(table1_data$Female_harm)


#0 = Male
#1 = Female
```



#Creating a new harmonized race variable in CABBS to align with BRFSS data

```{r}
library(dplyr)

table1_data <- table1_data %>%
  mutate(
    Race_multiracial = Race_AfricanAmerican + Race_Asian + Race_Caucasian +
                 Race_NativeAmerican + Race_PacificIslander + Race_Other,
    
    Race_harm = case_when(
      Race_multiracial > 1 ~ 6, 
      Race_Caucasian == 1 ~ 1,
      Race_AfricanAmerican == 1 ~ 2,
      Race_NativeAmerican == 1 ~ 3,
      Race_Asian == 1 ~ 4,
      Race_PacificIslander == 1 ~ 5,
      Race_Other == 1 ~ 7,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ))

table(table1_data$Race_harm)


#1 = White only
#2 = Black or African American only
#3 = American Indian or Alaskan Native only
#4 = Asian only
#5 = Native Hawaiian or other Pacific Islander only
#6 = Multiracial
#7 = Other 

```

#Creating First 2 columns of CABBS Table 1
```{r}
#install.packages("gtsummary")
library(gtsummary)
library(dplyr)

table1_data %>%
  mutate(
    household_income = factor(household_income,
      levels = 1:6,
      labels = c("$0-$14,999", "$15,000–$29,999", "$30,000–$74,999", "$75,000 and over", "Prefer not to answer", "Don't know")
    ),
     Retirement_status = factor(Retirement_status,
      levels = 1:2,
      labels = c("Yes", "No")
      ),
       Time_Since_Referral_yrs = as.numeric(Time_Since_Referral_yrs),
        WHODAS_EffectsOfDiffi_H1 = as.numeric(WHODAS_EffectsOfDiffi_H1),
        WHODAS_EffectsOfDiffi_H2 = as.numeric(WHODAS_EffectsOfDiffi_H2),
        WHODAS_EffectsOfDiffi_H3 = as.numeric(WHODAS_EffectsOfDiffi_H3),
    ) %>%
  select(Time_Since_Referral, Time_Since_Referral_yrs, Age_Referral, Gender, Race_AfricanAmerican, Race_Asian, Race_Caucasian, Race_NativeAmerican, Race_PacificIslander, Race_Other, Race_DeclinedToState, Ethnicity, RaceEthnicity_new, RaceEthnicity_final, YearsEducationUS, Edu_2levels, Occupational_role_categories, Current_employment_status_cat, Retirement_status, Marital_status_category, household_income, ADI_StateRank, ADI_NationalRank, ADI_SuppressionCode, SSS_community, SSS_US, SSS_childhood_community, Trust_total, Ever_ConcernedMemoryProblem, Ever_FHXAD, Ever_Alzheimers, Ever_MCI, Ever_Dementia, Self_ECog_score, PAL_mem, PAL_sum, GDS_Score, PHQ9_Total_time, WHODAS_Cognition_D1_1, WHODAS_Cognition_D1_4, WHODAS_Mobility_D2_1, WHODAS_Mobility_D2_5, WHODAS_SelfCare_D3_1, WHODAS_SelfCare_D3_2, WHODAS_GettingAlong_D4_1, WHODAS_GettingAlong_D4_2, WHODAS_LifestyleAct_D5_1, WHODAS_LifestyleAct_D5_5, WHODAS_Participation_D6_1, WHODAS_Participation_D6_5, WHODAS_unknown_2, WHODAS_EffectsOfDiffi_H1, WHODAS_EffectsOfDiffi_H2, WHODAS_EffectsOfDiffi_H3, Self_reported_health_baseline, Overall_health_30days, Ever_Stroke, Heart_disease, Hypertension, Diabetes, Cancer, Hearing_Loss, APOE, APS2_cat, BD_Status_collected_clean ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = BD_Status_collected_clean,  #stratification variable
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      Time_Since_Referral_yrs ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "Missing"
  ) %>%
  add_n() %>% 
  bold_labels()%>%
modify_header(c(
  label ~ "** **",
  stat_1 ~ "**CABBS participants without blood draw (n = {n})**",
  stat_2 ~ "**CABBS participants with blood draw (n = {n})**"
))

#Retirement status: 1 = yes, 2 = no
```

```{r, include = FALSE}

table1_data %>%
  select(Age_harm, Female_harm, Race_harm, Ethnicity_harm, RaceEthnicity_harm, Education_harm, Memory_harm, Health_harm, Stroke_harm, HeartDisease_harm, Hypertension_harm, Diabetes_harm, Cancer_harm, Hearing_harm, AB42, AB40, RATIO_AB4240, NPTAU217, PTAU217, RATIO_PTAU217, APOE, APS2_cat, BD_Status_collected_clean) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = BD_Status_collected_clean,  #stratification variable
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      AB42 ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      AB40 ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      RATIO_AB4240 ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      NPTAU217 ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      PTAU217 ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      RATIO_PTAU217 ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "Missing"
  ) %>%
  add_n() %>% 
  bold_labels()%>%
modify_header(c(
  label ~ "** **",
  stat_1 ~ "**CABBS participants without blood draw (n = {n})**",
  stat_2 ~ "**CABBS participants with blood draw (n = {n})**"
))

```




#Final cleaned CABBS table 1 without the bioplasma data to merge later
```{r, include = FALSE}
#install.packages("gtsummary")
library(gtsummary)

#Adding labels for each variable
table1_data <- table1_data %>% 
  mutate(
     Age_harm = factor(Age_harm,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6), 
      labels = c("55 - 59", "60 - 64", "65 - 69", "70 - 74", "75 - 79", "80 or older")
      ),
      Female_harm = factor(Female_harm,
      levels = 0:1,
      labels = c("Male", "Female")
      ),
     RaceEthnicity_harm = factor(RaceEthnicity_harm,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8),
      labels = c("Non-Latino White", "Non-Latino Black/African American", "Non-Latino American Indian or Alaskan Native", "Non-Latino Asian", "Non-Latino Pacific Islander", "Non-Latino Multiracial", "Latino/Hispanic", "Non-Latino Other")
     ),
     Education_harm = factor(Education_harm,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3),
      labels = c("High school graduate or less", "Some college or technical school", "College graduate")
     ),
     Memory_harm = factor(Memory_harm,
      levels = c(1, 0),
      labels = c("Yes", "No")
     ),
     Health_harm = factor(Health_harm,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
      labels = c("Excellent", "Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor")
     ),
    Stroke_harm = factor(Stroke_harm,
      levels = c(1, 0),
      labels = c("Yes", "No")
     ),
    HeartDisease_harm = factor(HeartDisease_harm,
      levels = c(1, 0),
      labels = c("Yes", "No")
     ),
    Hypertension_harm = factor(Hypertension_harm,
      levels = c(1, 0),
      labels = c("Yes", "No")
     ),
    Diabetes_harm = factor(Diabetes_harm,
      levels = c(1, 0),
      labels = c("Yes",	"No")
     ),     
    Cancer_harm = factor(Cancer_harm,
      levels = c(1, 0),
      labels = c("Yes", "No")
     ), 
    Hearing_harm = factor(Hearing_harm,
      levels = c(1, 0),
      labels = c("Yes", "No"))
     )

CABBS_harm <- table1_data %>%
  mutate(
       Time_Since_Referral_yrs = as.numeric(Time_Since_Referral_yrs),
       Gender = if_else(Gender == "Other", NA_character_, Gender),
       Gender = if_else(Gender == "Prefer not to say", NA_character_, Gender),
       Ethnicity = if_else(Ethnicity == "Declined To State", NA_character_, Ethnicity),
       BD_Status_collected_clean = factor(BD_Status_collected_clean,
      levels = c(1, 0))  #reordering my strata group so the blood draw participants come first
    ) %>%
  select(Age_harm, Female_harm, RaceEthnicity_harm, Education_harm, Memory_harm, Health_harm, Stroke_harm, HeartDisease_harm, Hypertension_harm, Diabetes_harm, Cancer_harm, Hearing_harm, BD_Status_collected_clean) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = BD_Status_collected_clean,  #stratification variable
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "Missing"
  ) %>%
  add_n() %>% 
  bold_labels()%>%
modify_header(c(
  label ~ "** **",
  stat_1 ~ "**CABBS participants with a blood draw (n = {n})**",
  stat_2 ~ "**CAL-BHR participants without a blood draw (n = {n})**"
))

print(CABBS_harm)
```

#Installing the CA BRFSS data version 1 to compare CAL-BHR participants to the general CA pop
```{r, include = FALSE}
#install.packages("haven")
library(haven)
BRFSS_data <- read_xpt("/Users/yoditgoshu/CABBS/LLCP22V1.XPT")    #installing the BRFSS dataset

library(dplyr)
BRFSS_CA <- BRFSS_data %>%
  filter(`_STATE` == 6, `_AGEG5YR` >= 8) %>%     #State = 6 is California, 8 = 55+ years old
  mutate(
    `_AGEG5YR` = if_else(`_AGEG5YR` == 14, NA_real_, `_AGEG5YR`),
    `_AGE65YR` = if_else(`_AGE65YR` == 3, NA_real_, `_AGE65YR`),
    `_MRACE2`  = if_else(`_MRACE2` %in% c(77, 88, 99), NA_real_, `_MRACE2`),
    `_HISPANC` = if_else(`_HISPANC` == 9, NA_real_, `_HISPANC`),
    `_RACE1`   = if_else(`_RACE1` == 9, NA_real_, `_RACE1`),
    EDUCA      = if_else(EDUCA == 9, NA_real_, EDUCA),
    `_EDUCAG`  = if_else(`_EDUCAG` == 9, NA_real_, `_EDUCAG`),
    CIMEMLOS   = if_else(CIMEMLOS %in% c(7, 8, 9), NA_real_, CIMEMLOS),
    GENHLTH    = if_else(GENHLTH %in% c(7, 8, 9), NA_real_, GENHLTH),
    CVDSTRK3   = if_else(CVDSTRK3 %in% c(7, 8, 9), NA_real_, CVDSTRK3),
    CVDCRHD4   = if_else(CVDCRHD4 %in% c(7, 8, 9), NA_real_, CVDCRHD4),
    CVDINFR4   = if_else(CVDINFR4 %in% c(7, 8, 9), NA_real_, CVDINFR4),
    DIABETE4   = case_when(
      DIABETE4 %in% c(7, 8, 9) ~ NA_real_,
      DIABETE4 %in% c(2, 4) ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(DIABETE4)
    ),
    CHCOCNC1   = if_else(CHCOCNC1 %in% c(7, 8, 9), NA_real_, CHCOCNC1),
    DEAF       = if_else(DEAF %in% c(7, 8, 9), NA_real_, DEAF)
  )
head(BRFSS_CA)

```


```{r, include = FALSE}
names(BRFSS_CA)
```

```{r}
    CHCOCNC1 == 2 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ))

table(BRFSS_CA$Cancer_harm)


#0 = No
#1 = Yes
```




#Creating a new harmonized hearing loss variable in BRFSS to align with the CABBS data

#Creating the unweighted version of the BRFSS table 1
```{r, include = FALSE}
library(gtsummary)

BRFSS_CA %>%
  mutate(
     `_AGEG5YR` = factor(`_AGEG5YR`,
      levels = c(8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13),
      labels = c("55 - 59", "60 - 64", "65 - 69", "70 - 74", "75 - 79", "80 or older")
      ),
      SEXVAR = factor(SEXVAR,
      levels = 1:2,
      labels = c("Male", "Female")
      ),
     `_MRACE2` = factor(`_MRACE2`,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6),
      labels = c("White only", "Black or African American only", "American Indian or Alaskan Native only", "Asian only", "Native Hawaiian or other Pacific Islander only", "Multiracial")
      ),
     `_HISPANC` = factor(`_HISPANC`,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("Hispanic, Latino/a, or Spanish origin", "Not of Hispanic, Latino/a, or Spanish origin")
     ),
     `_RACE1` = factor(`_RACE1`,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8),
      labels = c("White only, non-Hispanic", "Black only, non-Hispanic", "American Indian or Alaskan Native only, Non-Hispanic", "Asian only, non-Hispanic", "Native Hawaiian or other Pacific Islander only, Non-Hispanic", "Multiracial, non-Hispanic", "Hispanic")
     ),
     `_EDUCAG` = factor(`_EDUCAG`,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
      labels = c("Did not graduate High School", "Graduated High School", "Attended College or Technical School", "Graduated from College or Technical")
     ),
     CIMEMLOS = factor(CIMEMLOS,
      levels = 1:2,
      labels = c("Yes", "No")
     ),
     GENHLTH = factor(GENHLTH,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
      labels = c("Excellent", "Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor")
     ),
    CVDSTRK3 = factor(CVDSTRK3,
      levels = 1:2,
      labels = c("Yes", "No")
     ),
    CVDCRHD4 = factor(CVDCRHD4,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("Yes", "No")
     ),
    CVDINFR4 = factor(CVDINFR4,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("Yes", "No")
     ),    
    DIABETE4 = factor(DIABETE4,
      levels = c(1, 3),
      labels = c("Yes", "No")
     ),     
    CHCOCNC1 = factor(CHCOCNC1,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("Yes", "No")
     ), 
    DEAF = factor(DEAF,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("Yes", "No")
     ), 
     ) %>%
  select(`_AGEG5YR`, SEXVAR, `_MRACE2`, `_HISPANC`, `_RACE1`, `_EDUCAG`, CIMEMLOS, GENHLTH, CVDSTRK3, CVDCRHD4, CVDINFR4, DIABETE4, CHCOCNC1, DEAF ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "Missing",
       label = list(
      `_AGEG5YR` ~ "Fourteen-level Age Category",
      SEXVAR ~ "Sex",
      `_MRACE2` ~ "Calculated multiracial race categorization",
      `_HISPANC` ~ "Hispanic Origin",
      `_RACE1` ~ "Race/Ethnicity",
      `_EDUCAG` ~ "Level of education completed",
      CIMEMLOS ~ "During the past 12 months, have you experienced confusion or memory loss that is happening more often or is getting worse?",
      GENHLTH ~ "Would you say that in general your health is:",
      CVDSTRK3 ~ "Ever told you had a stroke?",
      CVDCRHD4 ~ "Ever told you had angina or coronary heart disease?",
      CVDINFR4 ~ "Ever told you had a heart attack, also called a myocardial infarction?",
      DIABETE4 ~ "Ever told you had diabetes?",
      CHCOCNC1 ~ "Ever told you had melanoma or any other types of cancer?",
      DEAF ~ "Are you deaf or do you have serious difficulty hearing?"
    )
  ) %>%
  add_n() %>% 
  bold_labels()%>%
modify_header(c(
  label ~ "**Variable**",
  stat_0 ~ "**General 2022 CA population (n = {n})**"
))

```

```{r, include = FALSE}
     ),
```

#Harmonized BRFSS tables used to merge later
```{r, include = FALSE}
library(survey)
library(gtsummary)
library(dplyr)

options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust") 

#Adding labels for each variable
BRFSS_CA_weighted <- BRFSS_CA %>% 
  mutate(
     Age_harm = factor(Age_harm,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6), 
      labels = c("55 - 59", "60 - 64", "65 - 69", "70 - 74", "75 - 79", "80 or older")
      ),
      Female_harm = factor(Female_harm,
      levels = 0:1,
      labels = c("Male", "Female")
      ),
     RaceEthnicity_harm = factor(RaceEthnicity_harm,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7),
      labels = c("Non-Latino White", "Non-Latino Black/African American", "Non-Latino American Indian or Alaskan Native", "Non-Latino Asian", "Non-Latino Pacific Islander", "Non-Latino Multiracial", "Latino/Hispanic")
     ),
     Education_harm = factor(Education_harm,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3),
      labels = c("High school graduate or less", "Some college or technical school", "College graduate")
     ),
     Memory_harm = factor(Memory_harm,
      levels = c(1, 0),
      labels = c("Yes", "No")
     ),
     Health_harm = factor(Health_harm,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
      labels = c("Excellent", "Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor")
     ),
    Stroke_harm = factor(Stroke_harm,
      levels = c(1, 0),
      labels = c("Yes", "No")
     ),
    HeartDisease_harm = factor(HeartDisease_harm,
      levels = c(1, 0),
      labels = c("Yes", "No")
     ),
    Diabetes_harm = factor(Diabetes_harm,
      levels = c(1, 0),
      labels = c("Yes",	"No")
     ),     
    Cancer_harm = factor(Cancer_harm,
      levels = c(1, 0),
      labels = c("Yes", "No")
     ), 
    Hearing_harm = factor(Hearing_harm,
      levels = c(1, 0),
      labels = c("Yes", "No"))
     )
   #Create survey design 
    brfssdsgn <- svydesign(
     id = ~`_PSU`,        #FIX HERE BACK TO ~1
     #strata = ~`_STSTR`,
     weights = ~`_LCPWTV1`, 
    data = BRFSS_CA_weighted
) 

  BRFSS_Harm <- brfssdsgn %>%
  tbl_svysummary(
    include = c(Age_harm, Female_harm, RaceEthnicity_harm, Education_harm, Memory_harm, Health_harm, Stroke_harm, HeartDisease_harm, Diabetes_harm, Cancer_harm, Hearing_harm),
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "Missing",
  ) %>%
  add_n() %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**",
                stat_0 ~ "**California population of older adults (n = {n})**")

print(BRFSS_Harm)
```

## Concatenating CABBS and BRFSS to create Table 1

<br>


#How to concatenate the datasets and advice given
1. create a study code to be able to easily stratify, so cabbs_BD, cabbs_noBD, BRFSS
2. subset the dataset to only keep the harmonized variables and weights
3. concatenate the datasets, apply the weights, and stratify by the study code


#Creating a study code so that we can easily stratify the concatented dataset into 3 columns
```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(dplyr)

table1_data <- table1_data %>%
  mutate(Study_code = case_when(
    BD_Status_collected_clean == 0 ~ "CABBS_noBD",
    BD_Status_collected_clean == 1 ~ "CABBS_BD",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))
table(table1_data$Study_code)


BRFSS_CA <- BRFSS_CA %>%
  mutate(Study_code = case_when(
    `_STATE` == 6 ~ "BRFSS",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))
table(BRFSS_CA$Study_code)

```


#Subsetting both datasets to only keep the variables we will need
```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(dplyr)

cabbs_subset <- table1_data %>%
  select(Study_code, subjectcode, Age_harm, Female_harm, Race_harm, Ethnicity_harm, 
         RaceEthnicity_harm, Education_harm, Memory_harm, Health_harm, 
         Stroke_harm, HeartDisease_harm, Hypertension_harm, Diabetes_harm, 
         Cancer_harm, Hearing_harm)



BRFSS_subset <- BRFSS_CA %>%
  select(Study_code, SEQNO, Age_harm, Female_harm, Race_harm, Ethnicity_harm, 
         RaceEthnicity_harm, Education_harm, Memory_harm, Health_harm, 
         Stroke_harm, HeartDisease_harm, Diabetes_harm, 
         Cancer_harm, Hearing_harm, `_PSU`, `_STSTR`, `_LCPWTV1` )

```



#Concatenating the datasets and setting weight of 1 to CABBS dataset
```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
Combined <- bind_rows(cabbs_subset, BRFSS_subset)
Combined$`_LCPWTV1`[is.na(Combined$`_LCPWTV1`)] <- 1
```



#Creating the concatenated Table 1 dataset (unweighted)
```{r,eval = FALSE}
library(gtsummary)

Combined %>%
  select(Age_harm, Female_harm, Race_harm, Ethnicity_harm, RaceEthnicity_harm, Education_harm, Memory_harm, Health_harm, Stroke_harm, HeartDisease_harm, Hypertension_harm, Diabetes_harm, Cancer_harm, Hearing_harm, Study_code)%>%
  
  tbl_summary(
    by = Study_code,  #stratification variable
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "Missing"
  ) %>%
  add_n() %>% 
  bold_labels()%>%
modify_header(c(
  label ~ "** **",
  stat_1 ~ "**BRFSS data (n = {n})**",
  stat_2 ~ "**CABBS participants with blood draw (n = {n})**",
  stat_3 ~ "**CABBS participants without blood draw (n = {n})**"
))
```



#Creating the FINAL concatenated Table 1 dataset (weighted)
```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(gtsummary)
library(survey)  

#Create survey design object
brfssdsgn <- svydesign(
  id = ~1,
  weights = ~`_LCPWTV1`, 
  data = Combined
)

tbl_svysummary(
  data = brfssdsgn,
  by = Study_code,
  statistic = list(
    all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
    all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
  ),
  missing = "ifany",
  missing_text = "Missing"
) %>%
  add_n() %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_header(c(
    label ~ "** **",
    stat_1 ~ "**BRFSS data (n = {n})**",
    stat_2 ~ "**CABBS participants with blood draw (n = {n})**",
    stat_3 ~ "**CABBS participants without blood draw (n = {n})**"
  ))


#This is giving an error so we will instead use the function, tbl_merge
```

## Looking into the association between Ecog score and our bioplasma data

<br>

```{r}
#Summary statistics of Ecog score by blood draw status, to assess if we have a sufficient sample
  ecog_summary <- table1_data %>%
group_by(BD_Status_collected_clean) %>%
  summarize(
    Count = sum(!is.na(Self_ECog_score)),
    Min = min(Self_ECog_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max = max(Self_ECog_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean = mean(Self_ECog_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(Self_ECog_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Self_ECog_score, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%

print(ecog_summary)

# We have 301 participants who completed the CABBS blood draw and have Ecog data, which is sufficient for the study
```
